title: Booking.com Hotel Prices Scraper
description: Compare Booking.com hotel prices by destination and stay dates, with property names, quoted prices, review scores, locations, and links. Search several cities in one run.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Cities, regions, or destination names to search for Booking.com hotel prices.

checkin.title: Checkin
checkin.description: Hotel check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When omitted, check-in is set to 30 days from today.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.description: Hotel check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after check-in. When omitted, check-out is set to two days after check-in.

group_adults.title: Group Adults
group_adults.description: Number of adults (1-30). Defaults to Booking.com default.

dest_id.title: Dest Id
dest_id.description: Booking.com destination id when known (e.g. -1456928 for Paris). Helps Booking render resolved city result pages.

dest_type.title: Dest Type
dest_type.description: Booking.com destination type when known: city, region, district, hotel, landmark, or airport. Accepted values: city, region, district, hotel, landmark, airport.
